value.overview: The Western/Eastern Cattle Egret is an eBird composite or slash taxon used when closely related pheasant forms are not separated confidently. Field recognition often comes from small white egret shape, short neck, yellowish or orange bill in many seasons, and open pasture or wet field feeding. In the U.S. source data, it appeared in 15 state or DC summaries, including AL, AR, AZ, CA, FL, GA, HI, KS, LA, MS, NC, OK, SC, SD, and 1 more. It is most associated with Grasslands:  Temperate and Grasslands:  Temperate, and local season should be checked before trip planning.
